title: Support extensionless source discovery through an explicit include_extensionless setting while preserving omitted and empty source_extensions defaults, with parser, scanner, strict file coverage, and LOC coverage regressions for extensionless-only and mixed projects
description: Support extensionless source discovery through an explicit include_extensionless setting while preserving omitted and empty source_extensions defaults, with parser, scanner, strict file coverage, and LOC coverage regressions for extensionless-only and mixed projects
acceptance_criteria: Configuration accepts include_extensionless = true while omitted or false include_extensionless and omitted or empty source_extensions retain existing default discovery.
An extensionless-only project discovers and maps a real source file with strict 100 percent file and LOC coverage over non-zero totals.
A mixed project discovers both configured suffixed and extensionless files with strict 100 percent file and LOC coverage over non-zero totals.
Parser, serialization, shared scanning, CLI integration, public documentation, canonical semantic deltas, and full native gates pass.
